description: Report how a paid call went. Spends nothing. A service credit may be added to the balance when the paid call was at least 20 sats. A smaller call is recorded and is not credited. The credit is not cash. Report credits pause after a few per account.

latency_ok.description: True when the call returned soon enough to use.

line.description: Line index when the order has more than one line. Omit it for a single-line order. (minimum 0).

matched_schema.description: True when the response matched the schema you were given.

useful.description: How useful the result was, from 1 to 5.

worked.description: True when the call did the job.

name: report_outcome

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.

title: Report outcome
